title: A deposit is charged to the owning location's payment account
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user. That role holds every permission, including BOTH Part sales -> Create & Edit AND Invoicing & payments -> Create & Edit.
  2. A customer to sell to exists; if none does, create one first: top menu Customers -> New Customer, enter a Name (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair") and click Save.
  3. Two locations exist (click your initials at the top right -> Settings -> Locations). A part sale owned by one location (e.g. Location A) while the user has a different location (Location B) selected: create the sale while Location A is selected, then click your initials at the top right -> Change Location -> pick Location B.
custom_steps:
1. With Location B selected, take a deposit on the Location-A sale.
  2. Check which location's account the deposit charges.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The deposit is charged to the account of the location that owns the part sale (Location A), not the location the user has selected (Location B).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10269 (Take a deposit on a part sale); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 8; design canvas boards S8_*; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
